faqs.question: How do I know it's the fan and not something else?
faqs.answer: A loud grinding or rattling noise, or the laptop overheating and shutting down under load, usually points to the fan. If the laptop is silent but still overheating, it may just need cleaning and fresh thermal paste. Ask us on WhatsApp before ordering.

faqs.question: Will this fan fit my ThinkPad?
faqs.answer: It is listed for the ThinkPad X240, X240s, X250, X260, X260s, X270 and X270s. The fan and heatsink are not identical across all of these, so send us your exact model, or a photo of the part number on your old fan, on WhatsApp and we'll confirm before you order.

faqs.question: Does it come with the heatsink?
faqs.answer: Yes, this is a CPU heatsink with the fan, so the whole assembly is replaced in one go. You will need thermal paste applied to the processor when it is fitted, and we do this when we fit it for you.

faqs.question: Can I fit this myself?
faqs.answer: It requires opening the base cover and removing the old heatsink and fan, then applying fresh thermal paste. Most customers have it fitted by us. We can talk you through it on WhatsApp if you'd rather do it yourself.

faqs.question: What warranty comes with this fan?
faqs.answer: This fan comes with a warranty. Message us on WhatsApp for the current term before ordering.
